final: WITH r AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, l.ID AS id, AVG(l.TAT2 * 1.0 / l.TAT) AS pavg FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX, l.ID), s AS (SELECT sex, AVG(pavg) AS savg FROM r GROUP BY sex), o AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS oavg FROM s) SELECT s.sex, s.savg, s.savg - o.oavg AS diff FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.oavg IS NOT NULL AND s.savg > o.oavg
